purpose: Find short, visually separable, FB-supported training clips for diagnosing C1 correspondence without fitting or selecting by C1 outcomes
scope: Current120 training images and frozen raw training forward/backward flow only; inventory other installed PIDG scenes without claiming detailed review
windows: All113 sliding windows of8 training observations, plus first5 observations as a shorter camera-motion control
ranking: Ascending maximum relative camera rotation from window start among qualified windows; greedy select up to3 windows with disjoint training observation indices; also show the separately declared first5 control
camera: Original transform_matrix poses, rotations orthonormalized by SVD only for angular measurement; report translation in scene coordinates, not meters
flow: Raw forward/backward fields; yellow and blue structure region flow/FB statistics; blue-region stationarity is a visual assumption, not independent3D GT
manual_review: Contact sheets of all selected observations plus native-resolution first/middle/last and per-duck crops in primary clip
interpretation: Separated visible silhouettes and supported tracklets do not prove full surfaces unoccluded or zero3D contact. Repeated scene/window observations are correlated. Candidate selection is not a new heldout benchmark or camera calibration proof.
